threat_and_enabling_condition: Tenant isolation defect combined with insufficient negative authorization tests
action: Add automated tenant-isolation tests and review data-access design before release
closure_criterion: Successful isolation suite and independent sample review

threat_and_enabling_condition: Phishing or credential reuse; MFA coverage incomplete on some paths
existing_assumption: MFA enabled on primary accounts only
action: Require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts and remove shared accounts
closure_criterion: Complete MFA coverage report and controlled account-recovery test

threat_and_enabling_condition: Compromised build credential or bypassed change review
action: Protect build secrets; require reviewed, traceable builds; separate release permissions
closure_criterion: Trace a release end-to-end and verify no single-person bypass

event: Recovery fails after deletion or encryption
threat_and_enabling_condition: Ransomware or operator error with mutable or untested backups
existing_assumption: Daily backups enabled; quarterly restore not evidenced
action: Maintain isolated immutable copies and quarterly restore tests with RTO/RPO measurement
closure_criterion: Successful sample restore within approved recovery targets

event: Cloud service exposed by unsafe change
threat_and_enabling_condition: Configuration error or bypassed infrastructure review
action: Automate configuration checks, require reviewed changes, and monitor drift
closure_criterion: Unsafe test configuration detected and blocked; exceptions logged

event: Delayed detection of compromise or misuse
threat_and_enabling_condition: Incomplete event coverage or poorly tuned alerts
action: Define critical log sources, tune alerts, and test after-hours escalation
closure_criterion: Exercise proves detection and escalation within one hour

event: Lost endpoint exposes a session or local files
threat_and_enabling_condition: Device theft or missing encryption and screen lock
action: Enforce endpoint management, encryption, lock, remote wipe, and exception tracking
closure_criterion: Compliant device inventory and sample configuration check

event: Support ticket exposed to unauthorized party
threat_and_enabling_condition: Excess supplier permissions or compromised support account
action: Minimize ticket data, review access, and assess supplier annually
closure_criterion: Access review and contract/data-processing review recorded

event: Source or secrets stolen from repository
threat_and_enabling_condition: Developer account compromise or secret committed to source
existing_assumption: Private repositories; access reviewed on request
action: Scan for secrets, review repository access quarterly, and rotate exposed credentials
closure_criterion: No active secrets in scan sample; access sample approved

threat_and_enabling_condition: Cloud region failure, defective change, or capacity pressure
existing_assumption: Initial recovery notes; no recurring exercise assumed
action: Improve availability monitoring, exercise continuity, and review customer recovery targets
closure_criterion: Documented exercise, fallback procedures, and availability review

event: Customer contract or instruction shared incorrectly
action: Restrict sharing, define retention/disposal, and review file permissions
closure_criterion: Sample confirms approved permissions and deletion schedule

event: Support or response unavailable when key person is absent
threat_and_enabling_condition: Operational knowledge depends on one person and is not documented
action: Document critical runbooks, train a backup, and exercise role handover
closure_criterion: Backup operator completes critical procedure using approved runbook
